en: Black‑and‑white landscape view showing a Central European rural valley with scattered houses and small villas surrounded by fields and dense coniferous forest. Dominating the right side is a large sandstone rock massif with vertical grooves and a forested top, reminiscent of a rock city formation. Low, wooded mountains and rolling hills form the distant background; there are no visible captions or borders on the picture side.
